notes.title: UPDATE #7: ULTRA UPDATE!
notes.content:
It’s finally here! The Void Invaders Ultra Update (version 1.7.0) is now live. Here’s a list of all the new features and changes:

New features (in-game)

Hardcore Mode

10 new levels
30 new enemies
2 new bosses
1 new powerup


New achievements

Wave Master
Completed
Hardcore player


New skin with rainbow (!!!) bullets
Various other things we probably forgot to mention

New features (other)

Scrolling leaderboards
View leaderboards from the main menu
Screenshake slider
Vsync setting
Gamepad vibration
Auto-fire setting
Gamepad control re-mapping
Alienware AlienFX support
Logitech ARX Control support

Improvements

Improved keyboard and gamepad controls
Improved menu
Improved statistics screen
Improved extras screen
Optimisation and performance improvements

Bug fixes

Key map changes through the pause menu are now correctly applied

Linux!

We’ve finally managed to port Void Invaders to Linux! Right now, the official supported distros are Debian and its most common variants, including Ubuntu, Xubuntu and Lubuntu. Other distributions may work, but you’ll have to install the required libraries manually, and we currently can’t offer support. If you use Debian (or one of its friends), you can use the “Play install dependencies” launch option to install necessary libraries, after which the game can be played.

Linux-specific bugs can be reported here.

Many thanks to our friend Flippylosaurus who helped with troubleshooting and who created the install scripts.

About Music Mode

We’d like to apologise again for Music Mode not being released with this update. Real life got in the way and we didn’t find time to turn it into something worth playing. That’s why we decided to postpone it indefinitely.

That’s all folks!

We’re pretty sure that this will be the last major update for Void Invaders (though we’ll stick around and try to fix any bugs you may find). We’ve had a great time working on Void Invaders, but everything comes to an end. After having worked on it for nearly two years, we’re ready to start working on something new.

Having a game on Steam truly has been an amazing experience, so thank you all for supporting us. We also genuinely hope you guys will enjoy the new update.

By the way, Void Invaders is 83% off right now as well! Be sure to spread the word!

Have fun and thanks for playing Void Invaders!!!

~VoidDev
Noah & Koen

notes.title: Quick Announcement - Ultra Update almost finished
notes.content:
Hi guys,

The Void Invaders Ultra Update is almost there! It will feature a new game mode, new levels and enemies, a new skin, additional settings and options, performance and general improvements, bug fixes and more!

We’re sorry we’ve kept you guys waiting so long, and we have some bad news as well. Personal problems, combined with a lack of motivation, have forced us to indefinitely postpone Music Mode. Apologies to those who were looking forward to it!

Right now, we’re tweaking the last couple things, while a friend is working on getting the Linux build working. We hope to have the update done as soon as possible (yes, we’ve said this before, but it’s for real now!)

Thanks for sticking with us.

VoidDev
Noah & Koen

notes.title: Void Invaders is still alive!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Happy summer sale! Void Invaders will be 83% off for the entire duration of the sale. Spread the word and tell your friends and enemies!

Shameless advertising aside, we wanted to let you know that we are still working on Void Invaders! A big update is in the works, which we’ll release somewhere in the next 1-2 months. The update will be completely free for everyone who owns the game.

Here’s a quick recap of a couple things that will be added to Void Invaders:

Hardcore Mode with new ultra-hard levels and enemies
Music Mode (with leaderboards!)
More settings, including auto-fire, gamepad vibration and control remapping
New achievements
Steam Cloud saves
Polishing, balancing and bug fixing
Improved menu
More rewards for beating the game and new game modes
A lot of other stuff that we either forgot to mention or is super secret


So without further ado, here are some sneak peeks of the Upcoming Ultra Update:

http://i.imgur.com/dceOdQs.gif
http://i.imgur.com/g4Ekurd.gif
http://i.imgur.com/j1cquBP.gif
http://i.imgur.com/EQKMKYU.gif

We realise we’ve made you wait for quite a while now, but we’re going to do our best to finish the update as soon as we can!

We’d also like to thank you guys for your support. It has been a blast so far to work on Void Invaders!

VoidDev
Noah & Koen

notes.title: Upcoming Ultra Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Hope you’re having fun playing Void Invaders! As we have mentioned before, we are working on another huge content update. Here are a couple things we will be adding:


Hardcore Mode: beat ultra-hard levels with new enemies and bosses
Music Mode: get the highest score before the track ends
New achievements
New leaderboards
New powerups
New skins
Steam Cloud saves
Polishing, balancing and bug fixing
More settings/options
AlienFX integration


Additionally, we’re looking into bringing the game to Linux, but we might delay that until another update. We want to make sure the game is great before attempting to port it!

Since this update is going to be really big, it’s going to take us a while to get everything ready. We’re not sure when we’ll be releasing it yet, but we’ll definitely keep you updated.

If you have any questions or suggestions, please post them in the discussions! We’d also be happy to hear your thoughts about this update.

Thanks for reading and for playing Void Invaders!

~Noah & Koen

notes.title: UPDATE #6: Anniversary and a small update
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We’ve got a couple things for you today.

First of all, Void Invaders turned 1 this week. Woohoo! We’d like to thank the awesome guys at Black Shell Media for bringing Void Invaders to Steam and of course everyone who has played it for the great feedback.

Secondly, we’ve published a small-ish update for you to enjoy. It features new highscore lists, meaning you can now see the top scores as well as your friends’ scores for both Endless and Wave mode. We’ve also added performance improvements and a couple bug fixes. The start-up problem when running the Steam Client beta should be fixed now.
The current version is 1.4.0.

We’re still working on adding more content to the game. If you have any suggestions, please let us know in the discussions!

Last of all, we’ve updated the promotional art to be more consistent across Steam. It’s a bit different, but we hope you like it!

~VoidDev

notes.title: UPDATE #5: Fixes and tweaks!
notes.content:
Hey guys and gals!

It’s been a while since the last update, but today we’re releasing another one! This update isn’t that big of a deal -- some fixes and tweaks that make Void Invaders a bit nicer.

Here’s what we’ve added and changed: 

Added:

More settings (separate music and sound volumes)
Settings have been added to the pause screen
Enemy list (unlocks after you beat level 30)


Improved:

HUD (powerup timers are more readable)
Splash screen (it’s shorter now!)
Settings (separate sections for different settings)
Main menu


Miscellaneous:

Fixed a lot of bugs
Controller support is now more stable
More optimisation
Scores load from the Steam leaderboards

The current version is 1.3.5.

Have fun and thanks for playing!
~VoidDev

notes.title: UPDATE #4: MEGA UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It took us a little longer than expected, but the new update is finally here! Due to some last-minute problems with the save system and Game Maker: Studio we decided to postpone the update, but it’s finished now! Thanks for your patience.

New features:

10 new levels
16 new enemies
2 new bosses
3 new achievements
2 new statistics
1 new powerup
1 new music track for the new levels
Entirely new ranking system
A new game mode: Wave Mode
Another leaderboard (for Wave Mode)
Easily recognisable hit sound and hurt effect for player
New hit effect for invincible enemies


Changes:

Tutorial is now shorter and skippable
Difficulties have been removed due to the new ranking system
Boss Mode has been removed and replaced by Wave Mode
Saves are local again; we’ve decided to remove Steam stats and cloud saves as they were causing trouble for many players
Achievements are now visible in Steam only


Fixes and improvements:

Overall in-game improvements
Enemy improvements
Minor improvements for Endless Mode
Menu improvements and glitch fixes
Optimisation and lag reduction
Particle system improvements
Interface improvements
Steam connection fixes and improvements
Achievements are kept on game reset
Minor graphical improvements


The current version is 1.3.1.

Oh yeah, we've also released the soundtrack as free DLC. Grab it  here!

If you encounter any problems or have any questions, please let us know as soon as possible! We’ve done our best to filter out all bugs and to make sure your saves stay intact, but if anything’s not right, be sure to notify us  in the discussions.

Enjoy and thanks for playing!

~VoidDev

notes.title: Update #4 coming soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First of all: happy Halloween!

Secondly: we’re working on a new update -- which will be packed with new content and huge improvements!

Here’s a few things that are going to be added:

10 brand new levels, including 2 challenging bosses
An improved ranking system
A new game mode, including leaderboards
A lot more enemies
New achievements
Free soundtrack DLC
Bug fixes, gameplay improvements and polishing


We’ve also decided to remove all difficulties, since an improved ranking system will be added.
Honestly, it didn’t add any value to the gameplay and just made everything more complicated and unstable. Due to this, the play time might be a bit shorter, but we’ve already partially made up for this with the new levels. We promise we’ll add new level packs in the future too!

We're expecting to release the update around November 14th.
If you have any questions or suggestions, please let us know in the comments.

Thanks for playing Void Invaders!

notes.title: UPDATE #3: Steam integration!
notes.content:
Hi there!

We’ve released another update for Void Invaders. This one’s pretty big, as we’ve added full Steam Integration!

That’s right; Void Invaders now has:

Steam Achievements - brand new ones!
Cloud Saves - your old saves will automatically be uploaded.
Leaderboards for Endless Mode!


This update also features some other improvements, including:

Fixes and improvements for Boss Mode and Endless Mode
Internal changes, making it easier for us to work on future updates
Gamepad improvements
Minor bug fixes

The current version is 1.1.0.

If you encounter any problems or have any questions, please let us know in the discussions!

Thanks for playing!

~VoidDev

We wanted to let you know that we're working on a big update for Void Invaders! We'll release it within at most two weeks, but probably earlier.

notes.title: UPDATE #1: Controller support!
notes.content:
Hey everyone.

We’ve just added controller support to Void Invaders! The entire game can now be controlled using a controller or the keyboard. We’ve tested it with an Xbox 360 controller and a PS3 controller (using the Scarlet.Crush XInput wrapper). If you experience any problems, please let us know!

We’ve also added more screen settings and options:

The ability to switch between full scale and fixed scale
An option to turn off screen shake
An option to turn off screen wobble

The current version is 1.0.4.

Be sure to tell us if you find any problems or have any suggestions, and stay tuned for more updates in the future!

~VoidDev
